goalZh: 会读一份几天的行程单,补全里面的省略句
canDoZh: 能看懂一份几天的旅行行程单,说出每天几点去哪儿、做什么

newItems.noteZh: 放在句首、句尾都行:Maybe the beach? / The beach, maybe?;一个词,和 may be(可能是)写法不同。

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Hey, guys! Here's our plan for LA!
lines.zh: (伊森发在群聊里)嘿,两位!这是我们的洛杉矶行程!

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Sunday, January 4th: Meet at the pier at 2:00. Beach time!
lines.zh: 1 月 4 日星期天:下午 2 点码头见。去海边!

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Monday, January 5th: I can drive you to a great view of LA.
lines.zh: 1 月 5 日星期一:我开车带你们去看洛杉矶全景。

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: At night, Mexican food. Sofia, you're going to love it!
lines.zh: 晚上吃墨西哥菜。索菲亚,你肯定喜欢!

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Tuesday, January 6th: Free day! The beach, maybe?
lines.zh: 1 月 6 日星期二:自由活动!也许去海边?

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Wednesday, January 7th: The museum in the morning.
lines.zh: 1 月 7 日星期三:上午去博物馆。

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Then lunch at home with my family.
lines.zh: 然后到我家和我家人一起吃午饭。

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Basketball near my home at night!
lines.zh: 晚上在我家附近打篮球!

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Thursday, January 8th: Your flight is in the evening.
lines.zh: 1 月 8 日星期四:你们的航班在晚上。

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Let's have lunch at the pier. Then the airport at 4:00.
lines.zh: 中午在码头吃饭,下午 4 点去机场。

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: It's going to be awesome. See you on Sunday!

questions.prompt: 第一天他们几点在哪儿见面?
questions.explainZh: Sunday, January 4th: Meet at the pier at 2:00.
Tuesday, January 6th: Free day! The beach, maybe?(博物馆和伊森家的午饭是 1 月 7 日。)
Let's have lunch at the pier. Then the airport at 4:00.(航班在晚上。)

grammar.bodyZh: 行程单、群聊里常用省略句,读的时候自己补全:Free day! = Tuesday is a free day.;The museum in the morning. = We're going to go to the museum in the morning.;Then the airport at 4:00. = Then we're going to go to the airport at 4:00.。日期的写法:Monday, January 5th(星期在前,日期在后,中间用逗号)。maybe 放在句首、句尾都行:Maybe the beach? / The beach, maybe?。

examples.zh: 1 月 6 日星期二:自由活动!
